feeds.title: WeAllSew
feeds.description: WeAllSew is a place where sewers and crafters of all ages and skill levels are celebrated and inspired through project ideas, patterns, and tips to fuel your creativity and love for sewing. Our mission is to inspire you about all things crafting, fashion, home décor, quilting, and embroidery.

feeds.title: Sew DIY Patterns Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Beth Wood and I'm the sewing-obsessed pattern designer and blogger here at Sew DIY. My goal is to make sewing an easier and more joyful experience for everyone. Covers tips, tutorials, downloads, and inspiration for designing your own DIY life. Get all the tips and tricks you need to learn how to sew your own handmade wardrobe with ease and joy.

feeds.title: Sewing Machine Greeks Blog
feeds.description: The Sewing Machine Greeks blog is your go-to destination for all things sewing machines, textile industry insights, and invaluable sewing tips. Enhance your sewing skills with expert tips and tutorials that cater to all skill levels, making sewing a joyous and creative experience.

feeds.title: The Sewing Machine Project Blog
feeds.description: The Sewing Machine Project collects and distributes sewing machines to groups committed to using the machines to provide opportunities to create, learn new skills, build self-confidence, and contribute to their own livelihoods and the well-being of their families and communities.

feeds.title: Bob's Vintage Sewing Machine Service Blog
feeds.description: When someone says 'they don't make 'em like they used to', it's especially true with sewing machines, and for very good reason - they can't afford to make them to that level of quality and durability anymore. There is something inherently beautiful about the mechanisms of our old gals, many wells over 100 years old, still producing perfect stitches. That is the essence of our mission; to keep 'em stitching, for generations to come.

feeds.title: Embroidery-Pro Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to sew like a pro with our expert sewing tips and techniques. From beginner basics to advanced techniques, we've got you covered with everything you need to know to get started.

feeds.title: Sewing Machine Buffs
feeds.description: Hello, I am Jessica Flores, and you are welcome to my website. I am a professional fashion designer and a seamstress. On this website, you will learn the tips to buy a sewing or embroidery machine while saving cost as much as possible. I will share my experience with all aspects of sewing, quilting, and embroidery. I will give you the best advice along with step-by-step guides to various sewing aspects starting from materials required for hemming pants to the actual process of doing it.

feeds.title: Sewing Empire Blog
feeds.description: Sewing Empire is here with a small team. We all love to sew & somehow connected to the fashion industry. Here, we'll help you in finding the best tool for sewing. Also, if you are having difficulty with your sewing tools, we are here to help you.

feeds.title: SewingWire
feeds.description: Welcome to Sewingwire, a community dedicated to helping sewists of all levels find the best tools and products for their sewing projects. We are passionate about sewing and believe that having the right equipment and supplies can make a world of difference in the quality and enjoyment of your work.

feeds.title: Sewing Machine World Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Sewing Machine World. We are a proper brick-and-mortar sewing machine shop with over 50 years of experience.

feeds.title: My Sewing Machine Obsession
feeds.description: A blog devoted to my vintage sewing machines and how I find them, fetch them, and fix them.

feeds.title: 10 Sewing Machines and a Serger
feeds.description: I am Stephanie. I enjoy creating with quality fabrics and techniques to incorporate color, beauty and love into life. I'm a blogger, sewist, couture enthusiast.

feeds.title: Pungoliving Blog
feeds.description: First and foremost, I decided to share some of my experiences with vintage all-metal sewing machines. My wife loves to sew, and I like tinkering with and restoring superbly engineered precision all-metal vintage sewing machines. Perfect hobby in my retirement where I can spend my time doing things I enjoy, and my Wife can sew on a variety of fine sewing machines, and offer her advice and opinions.

feeds.title: GUR The Sewing Lounge Blog
feeds.description: Wonderful hints and tips for sewists everywhere. Product information, videos, and how-tos for everything sewing. GUR Sewing Superstore, formerly GUR Sewing Machines, was established by a team of driven individuals who have incredible passion and knowledge of the sewing industry.

feeds.title: Online Sewing Machine
feeds.description: Online Sewing Machine are a group of experts who do comprehensive testing and then write a full guide with the honest testing results on various sewing machine models providing beginner sewists knowledge regarding everything along with 'How to' Guides.

feeds.title: Bamber Sewing Machines Blog
feeds.description: 75 years on and the Bamber Boys are still repairing and selling sewing machines. Brothers Alan and Steve run the business with their team of skilled, dedicated staff. You will find over 70 machines and overlockers in our showroom and all the best makes of machines, cabinets, and a wide range of haberdashery, and sewing patterns on our website.

feeds.title: Sewing Machination
feeds.description: I'm Amelia and welcome to my blog. Sewing Machinations is a place where I write about my adventures in sewing my own clothes, which I started doing in 2013.
